title: Agent Workforce Update
tagline: What your digital colleagues have been doing
intro: A look back at June. The agent workforce now spans thirteen mailboxes across four brands — the sales assistant went live for Smeba, Fire Control and Berki, and info@ mail is now routed to the right team automatically. It reads, sorts and matches every email and prepares the next step, still changing nothing in shadow and dry-run until each mailbox is signed off.
mailbox_caption: Emails received per mailbox · last 45 days
status_live: Acts on its own in your inbox — sorting, labelling and routing. (You still send the replies.)
status_dryrun: Labels mail in Outlook with the detected intent, but takes no automatic action on it yet.
status_shadow: Runs behind the scenes — you only see it in the Bulk Review tool. Nothing changes in Outlook.

learning_spotlight.title: It learns from how you work
learning_spotlight.body: It watches how you correct it, and improves with every edit.
points: Change or remove a label → it learns the label was wrong.
Drag an email elsewhere → it learns where it belongs.
Edit or reject a draft → it sharpens the next suggestion.
